model: Cavalier 'Mountain Men' Infantry Guard; Magistracy Cavaliers

fluff.overview: The Cavalier "Mountain Men" Infantry Guard of the Magistracy Cavaliers are mountain warfare specialists recruited from the citizens of Thraxa, a rugged world on the Canopian frontier. Trained to fight at altitudes where conventional infantry cannot operate effectively, these troops are immune to the effects of thin atmospheres and can traverse steep vertical terrain at three times the rate of standard soldiers using specialized climbing gear. Deployed in two-squad platoons of fourteen troops, each "Mountain Man" carries an Imperator AX-22 assault rifle, while two heavy mortars provide indirect fire support that is doubly dangerous in mountain terrain. The mortar crews are trained to use their weapons to trigger avalanches and rockslides against enemies operating below them, turning the terrain itself into a weapon. New recruits are initiated by surviving on Thraxa's rough northern continent with nothing but a knife, a snowsuit, and boots. The Magistracy Cavaliers grew out of Clayborne's Commandos, a volunteer battalion on Thraxa that was built into a full regiment after proving itself during the Pirate War of 3057. The Cavaliers' infantry component earned a reputation as the best in the MAF, and the Mountain Men represent the most specialized element of that force.
